06 / THE INSTITUTION / ASENTXIA SYSTEMS

For intelligence that endures.

Asentxia Systems is building machine-native infrastructure for autonomous intelligence: architecture for persistent, governed principals, and the systems through which that architecture can be implemented and tested.

THE THESIS

The thesis

Autonomous systems are asked to persist, accumulate state, exercise authority, act across real systems, recover from failure, and coordinate over time. Their underlying infrastructure still often centers continuity on temporary sessions, processes, credentials, and hosts. Asentxia organizes around the persistent autonomous principal.

The principal persists. The components may change.

THE WORK

The work

DCA sets the reference architecture. Continuum implements it for VERAs. The Regency addresses mandates, policy, roles, membership, organizations, and human control. Supporting systems and research contribute lineage under explicit maturity boundaries.

Explore the systems ↗

A STANDARD OF EVIDENCE

A standard of evidence

Architecture, tested implementation, integration, research, and verified behavior are presented separately. The current public launch story is a bounded same-host persistence slice, with exact public artifacts still to be linked.
